title: Shorten for Android
description: The Rift Works app for small routines. Build a flow from a few steps - ask, pick, calculate, set a date - and finish it with a calendar event, a reminder or a notification; run it from the app or a home screen widget.

details.label: Works on
details.value: Android 10 or newer, phones and tablets

details.label: Permissions
details.value: Calendar (to add your events), notifications, internet access to look for updates, and permission to install its own updates. No camera, location, contacts or files

details.label: Account needed
details.value: None. Shorten works on the phone, without signing in

whats_new.heading: What's new in 0.1.2
items: Widgets fill their tile: flow colour edge to edge with a large white icon; grid tiles match.
New action Append to File: adds a date-stamped line to a text file you pick once, on the phone or in Google Drive.
New action Send to App: sends text to Samsung Notes, Google Keep or any other app as a new note.

install.heading: How to install
steps: Tap Download, then open the file when it finishes.
If your phone asks, allow your browser to "install unknown apps". This is asked once.
Tap Install. If you already have Shorten, this updates it and keeps your data.

verify.heading: Verify your download (optional)
verify.note: The file checksum changes with every release; the signing certificate stays the same.
